headline: Revisión del uso de lectores automáticos de placas y cámaras Flock Safety de la ciudad, y sus contratos.
summary: Los Comités de Asuntos Legales y de Servicios Públicos van a tener una reunión conjunta para revisar el uso de lectores automáticos de placas y software relacionado de la ciudad, incluyendo cámaras Flock Safety.
items: Revisar el uso de lectores automáticos de placas y software relacionado de la ciudad, incluyendo cámaras Flock Safety (Orden #120)
review: headline: The contracts are left ambiguous. In the Spanish, "y sus contratos" is placed after the cameras, so it can read as contracts for the Flock cameras only. It also drops the link to the readers, which the English says covers both the use of and the contracts for the readers and the cameras.; summary: The contracts are left out. The English says the committees will review the City's use of and contracts for the readers and software. The Spanish only reviews the use ("revisar el uso de lectores... y software") and omits "contracts".; items 1: The contracts are left out. The English says to review the City's use of and contracts for the readers and software. The Spanish only says "Revisar el uso de..." and omits "contracts".
